_comment: Entirely fictional demo data. Companies, outlets, people and events are invented; all domains use the reserved .example TLD. Dates are offsets from 'now'.

feeds.title: Kestrel Code launches background agents that open pull requests on their own
feeds.snippet: Kestrel Code's new background agents pick up tickets from an issue tracker, work in a cloud sandbox and open a pull request for human review. "We want the agent to be the teammate who never forgets the boring ticket," said chief executive Mara Quill. Available on the Team plan from today.

feeds.title: Tern Labs cuts Tern CLI Pro price to $12 a month and adds a free tier
feeds.snippet: Tern Labs has halved the price of its terminal coding agent and introduced a free tier capped at 50 agent runs a month, a move analysts read as a land-grab ahead of larger rivals' pricing changes.

feeds.title: Survey: 41% of engineering managers now track AI-assisted pull requests separately
feeds.snippet: A survey of 600 engineering managers by the fictional Delta Eng Council found 41% now label AI-assisted pull requests, mostly to measure review load rather than to restrict use.

reddit.title: [r/ExampleDevTeams] Our team tried background agents for a sprint. Review load doubled.
reddit.snippet: We let agents pick up low-priority tickets for two weeks. Throughput looked great until we counted review hours: every agent PR needed a senior reviewer, and the nits were relentless.

reddit.title: [r/ExampleCodingTools] Anyone moved from Tern CLI to Kestrel after the price change?
reddit.snippet: Tern's free tier is tempting, but Kestrel's background agents are the first thing that has actually saved me time on chores.
